q: 商店的门还___，你快进去吧。
en: The shop door is still open, so go in quickly.

q: 他手里一直拿___一张购物卡。
en: He has been holding a shopping card in his hand the whole time.

q: 她从早上到现在一直戴___那条新项链。
en: She has been wearing that new necklace all day, from morning until now.

q: 篮球场的灯还___呢，他们还在练球。
en: The lights at the basketball court are still on; they are still practising.

q: 跑步机一直开___，电费特别高。
en: The treadmill has been left running all the time, so the electricity bill is very high.

q: 比赛早就结束了，他还穿___球衣呢。
en: The match ended long ago and he is still wearing his jersey.

q: 虽然商场已经关门了，可是后门还___，我们进去看看吧。
en: Although the mall has already closed, the back door is still open, so let's go in and look.

q: 妈妈___试鞋，你先别催她。
en: Mom is trying on shoes, so don't rush her.

q: 小王穿___一件红球衣，很好认。
en: Xiao Wang is wearing a red jersey, so he is easy to spot.

q: 店员___开门，你再等一分钟。
en: The clerk is opening up the shop, so wait one more minute.

q: 窗户___，你把它关上吧。
en: The window is open, so close it.

q: 他___外套，你等他一下，马上就好。
en: He is putting on his coat, so wait for him a moment; he'll be ready soon.

q: 我发现体育馆的门一直___，所以好多人随便进出。
en: I found that the gym door had been open all along, so lots of people came and went as they pleased.

q: 小李___一件黑色的运动服，我一眼就认出他了。
en: Xiao Li was wearing a black tracksuit, and I recognised him at a glance.

q: 他___打电话，不能和我们去买东西。
en: He is on the phone and can't go shopping with us.

q: 老板娘笑___收下了我的钱。
en: The shopkeeper took my money with a smile.

q: 他站___吃冰淇淋。
en: He eats his ice cream standing up.

q: 弟弟每天骑___自行车去公园打球。
en: My younger brother rides his bike to the park to play ball every day.

q: 她哭___跑出了商店，钱包也忘在柜台上了。
en: She ran out of the shop crying and even left her wallet on the counter.

q: 他靠___墙看球赛，一动也不动。
en: He leaned against the wall watching the match, without moving at all.

q: 老人们坐___下棋，一坐就是一下午。
en: The old men sit playing chess, and once they sit down it lasts the whole afternoon.

q: 弟弟光___脚在球场上跑来跑去。
en: My younger brother ran around the pitch barefoot.

q: 孩子抱___篮球睡着了，怎么叫也叫不醒。
en: The child fell asleep hugging a basketball and could not be woken however hard we called.

q: 购物车里___几瓶水。
en: There are a few bottles of water in the shopping cart.

q: 门上___一张通知，说商店今天休息。
en: A notice is stuck on the door saying the shop is closed today.

q: 商店门口___很多自行车。
en: Lots of bicycles are parked at the shop entrance.

q: 看台上___很多球迷，都在大声喊。
en: Lots of fans are sitting in the stands, all shouting loudly.

q: 海报上___“周末大减价”五个字。
en: The five characters 'weekend big sale' are written on the poster.

q: 体育馆的墙上___一块大屏幕，上面正播着比赛。
en: A big screen hangs on the wall of the stadium, showing a match.

q: 钱包里还___两百块钱，够买这双球鞋了。
en: There are still two hundred yuan in the wallet, enough for these shoes.

q: 那家运动用品店的橱窗里___好几双新球鞋，价格都不便宜。
en: Several pairs of new shoes are displayed in the window of that sports shop, and none of them is cheap.

q: 你___这个袋子，我去付钱。
en: Hold this bag while I go and pay.

q: 你在这儿___，我去买票。
en: Wait here while I go and buy tickets.

q: 比赛进行的时候，请大家___，不要站起来。
en: While the match is on, please stay seated and do not stand up.

q: 这张发票你先___，退货的时候要用。
en: Hang on to this receipt for now, as you'll need it when you return the goods.

q: 你们___，下周的比赛很重要。
en: Listen up, next week's match is important.

q: 你累了就___休息吧，不用起来帮忙。
en: If you're tired, just stay seated and rest; there's no need to get up and help.

q: 窗户___开着，是关着的。
en: The window isn't open; it is closed.

q: 他今天___戴着眼镜，我差点没认出来。
en: He wasn't wearing glasses today, and I almost didn't recognise him.

q: 你___坐着了，起来和我们一起打球吧。
en: Stop sitting there and come play ball with us.

q: 球场上的灯___亮着，我们看不清球。
en: The lights on the pitch aren't on, so we can't see the ball clearly.

q: 商店的门___锁着，我一推就开了。
en: The shop door wasn't locked; it opened as soon as I pushed.

q: 她手里___拿着钱包，原来钱包忘在家里了。
en: She wasn't holding her wallet; it turns out she had left it at home.

q: 爷爷___在沙发上看球赛。
en: Grandpa is lying on the sofa watching the match.

q: 爷爷在沙发上___看球赛。
en: Grandpa is lying on the sofa watching the match.

q: 小王喜欢___歌做作业。
en: Xiao Wang likes to sing while doing his homework.

q: 奶奶一直在商店门口坐___，等孙子买完球鞋。
en: Grandma has been sitting at the shop door waiting for her grandson to finish buying sneakers.

q: 他们边喝___茶边聊最近的球赛。
en: They chatted about recent matches while drinking tea.

q: 我不知道___这家店几点关门。
en: I don't know what time this shop closes.

q: 我们在商店门口等___三个小时，他才来。
en: We waited at the shop door for three hours before he came.

q: 教练说的话我都听懂___，不用再说了。
en: I understood everything the coach said, so there's no need to say it again.

q: 我觉得___这双鞋有点儿贵，你觉得呢？
en: I think these shoes are a bit expensive. What do you think?

q: 我哥哥现在在___超市，不在家。
en: My older brother is at the supermarket now, not at home.

q: 他去年大学毕业___，现在在体育用品店工作。
en: He graduated from university last year and now works in a sports shop.

q: 比赛七点开始，我们六点半就到___体育场了。
en: The match starts at seven, and we had already arrived at the stadium by half past six.
Several pairs of new sneakers are displayed on the counter.
The boss said, shaking his head, "I can't go any cheaper."
The fans watched the whole match standing up.
He is wearing an old jersey.
The lamp on the desk is still on.
Hold on to these tickets for now.
Remember to bring your sneakers.
He isn't wearing a coat today.
Don't come in wearing a hat.
Xiao Wang is standing at the edge of the pitch.
She walked out of the shop singing.
The kids are playing football on the pitch.

I waited for him for an hour.

task: Make the smile the manner of giving the change: one clause with 着.

en: He runs while listening to music.
src: 他一边听音乐，一边跑步。
task: Say it with 着: listening is the background.

src: 有一张球赛海报，挂在墙上。
